issues.title: Inconsistent Chinese translation for 'Name' field across namespaces
issues.description: The PR updates the Chinese translation for 'Name' from '称呼' to '姓名' across multiple translation files to ensure consistency. However, this change creates a cross-namespace inconsistency issue. In ghost.json, line 31 shows 'Name' translated as '名字' (first name), while in portal.json line 117 it's translated as '名称' (generic name/title). This inconsistency will confuse Chinese users when they see different terminology for the same 'Name' field between email templates (using ghost namespace) and the portal UI (using portal namespace). The correct translation should be '姓名' (full name) consistently across both files as intended by the original PR.

issues.title: Missing interpolation variable in newsletter unsubscribe message
issues.description: The translation for the key '{memberEmail} will no longer receive {newsletterName} newsletter.' in portal.json is missing the {newsletterName} interpolation variable. The Chinese translation only includes '{memberEmail}将不会再收到新闻信。' which omits the newsletter name placeholder. This means when users unsubscribe from a specific newsletter, they won't see which newsletter they're unsubscribing from, leading to confusion and potential accidental unsubscriptions. The translation should include both {memberEmail} and {newsletterName} variables to match the English source and maintain functional parity.

issues.title: Translation inconsistency for 'Enter your name' field across UI contexts
issues.description: The PR introduces an inconsistency in the Chinese translation for the 'Enter your name' input field. In portal.json line 71, it's translated as '输入您的名字' (enter your first name), which suggests only a first name is needed. However, based on the context of Ghost's user registration and profile system, and the fact that the 'Name' field itself should be '姓名' (full name), this creates a mismatch between what the label asks for ('名字' - first name) and what the system actually expects ('姓名' - full name). This can cause user confusion during registration and profile completion, potentially leading to incomplete or incorrectly formatted name entries.

issues.title: Deletion of comments.json breaks comments-ui build for Chinese locale
issues.description: The PR deletes ghost/i18n/locales/zh/comments.json, but this file is required by the comments-ui application build configuration. In apps/comments-ui/vite.config.mts line 56, the Vite build explicitly declares dynamicRequireTargets for comments.json across all SUPPORTED_LOCALES, including 'zh'. When the build system attempts to bundle the Chinese locale translations, it will fail because the required comments.json file no longer exists. This will break the build process for the comments-ui application or cause runtime failures when users try to view comments in Chinese.

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #25696 - Align zh translations with China mainland terminology.

structured_output.summary:
This PR is meant to change only wording in the Simplified Chinese (`zh`) locale. It moves subscription terms from 会籍 to 订阅, uses 评论 for "Comment", fills in the empty "Subscription details" string in `ghost.json`, and smooths several portal messages. Most of those edits are good, and the 订阅 change is applied the same way across ghost.json and portal.json.

The diff has two real problems. First, it deletes `ghost/i18n/locales/zh/comments.json` outright, even though the description says that file was "refined". When the file is missing, `generateResources` quietly loads `en/comments.json`, so Chinese readers would see the comments widget entirely in English. Second, the translation of `{memberEmail} will no longer receive {newsletterName} newsletter.` drops the `{newsletterName}` placeholder. The unsubscribe confirmation then no longer says which newsletter was removed, and the i18n lint's no-unused-variables rule should flag it. There are also a few smaller wording issues: portal "Name" becomes 名称, which means the name of a thing rather than a person; a status label changes tense; and one string uses a newsletter term (邮件通讯) that doesn't match the rest of the file.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The whole zh comments translation file is deleted, which sends Chinese users back to English, and a required interpolation variable is removed. Both are user-facing regressions that contradict the PR's stated intent of a text-only refinement.

architecture.overview:
Ghost keeps its UI strings in `ghost/i18n/locales/<locale>/<namespace>.json`. Each namespace (portal, comments, ghost, signup-form, search) is a flat JSON map from the English source string to its translation. `ghost/i18n/lib/i18n.js#generateResources` loads `../locales/${locale}/${ns}.json` with `require()`. If that file is missing, the catch block silently loads `../locales/en/${ns}.json` instead. The frontend apps (Portal, Comments UI) and the server email templates call `t(key, vars)`, and values such as `{newsletterName}` are filled in at render time.

This PR only changes data in the `zh` locale. It rewrites values in `ghost.json` and `portal.json`, and it deletes `zh/comments.json`. Because of the fallback above, that deletion changes what the Comments app shows: the `zh` comments namespace now loads the English file.
steps: Start at `ghost/i18n/lib/i18n.js` `generateResources` (lines 13-30). It requires the locale file and falls back to `en` when the file is missing.
Look at `ghost/i18n/locales/zh/`. `comments.json` is gone in this PR, so the `zh` comments namespace now loads the English file.

Look at `zh/portal.json`. Most values are only reworded, but the `{newsletterName}` translation (line 9) no longer contains its variable. That variable is supplied by `account-email-page.js` and `unsubscribe-page.js`.
Look at `zh/ghost.json`. These are server-side email/member strings; 会籍 becomes 订阅 throughout and 'Subscription details' is now filled in.
The `ghost/i18n/test/i18n.lint.js` rules (no-unused-variables, no-undefined-variables) check that each translation uses the same placeholders as its key.

findings.title: zh/comments.json deleted entirely, so the Comments UI falls back to English for Chinese users
findings.fixPrompt: The PR deleted `ghost/i18n/locales/zh/comments.json`, so `generateResources` in `ghost/i18n/lib/i18n.js` falls back to English for the zh comments namespace. Restore the file from the base commit (`git checkout 96253df719941a6de5cff4a348db0ffd23e1d3da -- ghost/i18n/locales/zh/comments.json`). Then apply only the wording refinements the PR describes: use 评论 consistently instead of 留言 (e.g. '{amount} more'), use 名字 for 'Name' and 'Enter your name' instead of 称呼, and make the load/show hints clearer (e.g. 'Show {amount} more replies' and 'Show 1 more reply' should say 回复, not 评论). Keep every existing key and all `{amount}`/`{publication}` placeholders.

findings.title: {newsletterName} placeholder dropped from unsubscribe confirmation
findings.fixPrompt: In `ghost/i18n/locales/zh/portal.json` line 9, the translation for `{memberEmail} will no longer receive {newsletterName} newsletter.` dropped the `{newsletterName}` placeholder. Portal supplies that variable in `apps/portal/src/components/pages/account-email-page.js` and `unsubscribe-page.js`. Put it back, e.g. `{memberEmail}将不会再收到{newsletterName}的新闻信。`, then run the i18n lint (`ghost/i18n/test/i18n.lint.js`) to confirm there are no unused or undefined variable errors.

findings.title: Portal 'Name' field label changed to 名称, which means the name of a thing rather than a person
findings.fixPrompt: In `ghost/i18n/locales/zh/portal.json` line 117, the 'Name' key was changed to 名称. That word is for the name of an object or organization, but Portal uses this key for the member's personal name input (signup-page.js, account-profile-page.js, offer-page.js). Change it back to 名字 (or 姓名) so it matches `ghost/i18n/locales/zh/ghost.json` line 31.

findings.title: 'You're not receiving emails' status label changed to future tense
findings.fixPrompt: In `ghost/i18n/locales/zh/portal.json` line 213, 'You're not receiving emails' was translated as 您将不会收到邮件 (future tense). It is a current-status label in `apps/portal/src/components/pages/AccountHomePage/components/email-preferences-action.js`. Change it to a present-state phrasing such as 您目前收不到邮件 so it matches the 'You're currently not receiving emails' entry on line 212.

findings.title: New 邮件通讯 term doesn't match 新闻信 used everywhere else
findings.body:
::diff{file="ghost/i18n/locales/zh/portal.json" lines="124-124"}

The rewritten resubscribe help text calls the newsletter 邮件通讯. Every other portal string uses 新闻信 for "newsletter" ("Email newsletter", "Email newsletter settings updated", the unsubscribe messages, and so on), and this is now the only place 邮件通讯 appears in the file. Either keep 新闻信 here, or switch the whole file in a separate, deliberate change.
findings.fixPrompt: In `ghost/i18n/locales/zh/portal.json` line 124, the 'Once resubscribed…' translation uses 邮件通讯 for 'newsletter', but the rest of the file uses 新闻信. Replace 邮件通讯 with 新闻信 in that value so the terminology is consistent.

findings.title: Good: 会籍 → 订阅 applied consistently, and the empty string filled in
findings.body:
The switch from 会籍 to 订阅 is applied consistently across ghost.json (manage/expire/renew/cancel strings) and portal.json (`Failed to update subscription`). It also now matches portal strings that already used 订阅, such as `Your subscription will expire on {expiryDate}`. Filling in `"Subscription details": "订阅详情"` fixes a real empty string; an empty value would have shown nothing in member emails.
